svg.desc: ScadaCraft OpenBridge widget: On/off valve (obc-digital-valve, OpenBridge 1.0.0, Apache-2.0). Library: OpenBridge · Automation (P&ID). Box 120x120 px, anchor at (48,48). Bindable properties: _pb_open (default false, read): Open feedback _pb_vertical (default false, read): Vertical orientation (pipe runs top-bottom) _ps_labelDirection (default 'down', read): Readout side: up | down | left | right _pb_alarm (default false, read): Alarm active (alert frame) _pb_auto (default false, read): Badge: automatic mode _pb_locked (default false, read): Badge: command locked _pb_duty (default false, read): Badge: duty unit _pb_alarmOff (default false, read): Badge: alarms suppressed _ps_tag (default '', read): Numeric equipment ID shown as #NNNN, e.g. 401 (empty = hidden) _pb_command (default false, write): Open/close command, written on click as !open (1/0)
